ns2:section.sectionText: This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design. This course requires students to access facilities on UIUC campus. This hybrid course includes limited in-person meetings. Most course content will be available online. Students are required to use Audio-Visual recording equipment (accessible through the Art and Design checkout window) and Adobe video editing software (accessible in Art and Design computer labs and/or for purchased-subscription through webstore.illinois.edu for use on personal computers).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art and Design or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s).
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Art Design ICT, First Time Freshman, or Transfer student - first time students.
